why.A: Feedback changes the interpretation of frozen source evidence.
why.B: B depends on A and carries its incorrect interpretation into an acceptance rule or recommendation.
why.report: The report depends on A and B, so its claims and conclusion require revision.
why.ledger: The ledger depends on the report, so its exact claims, report hash, and attempt binding require revision.
why.C: C depends only on the unchanged source and records correct scope limits. Reuse its original bytes.
why.source: The source has no changed dependency. Its facts and bytes remain frozen.

graph_path_convention: The extracted graph retains original case-prefixed paths. Local copies use initial/ within this case directory.
